title: Development + Growth Thread — 1:1 prep (Ezra → report)
content:
Meeting goal: quick sync to unblock current sprint work, surface career priorities, and agree concrete next steps.

Context:
- Report switched to backend team six weeks ago (onboarding mostly done). Working on autoscaling throttling bug that surfaced in staging.
- Recent PRs: refactor/kv-cache-shim (in review), perf/continuous-batching (merged, needs load test follow-up).
- Scorecard: velocity down 20% last two sprints due to context switching and flaky infra.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
1) 5m — quick personal check-in (non-work)
2) 10m — blockers + sprint health (what's preventing flow?)
3) 7m — career & growth (mentoring, stretch projects)
4) 5m — concrete actions + next checkpoint

Prep notes / prompts for report:
- How confident are you on the autoscale throttling fix? Any unknowns left? (Ask for root-cause summary in 2 bullets)
- Which part of the codebase feels most fragile right now? (probe for ownership opportunities)
- Are you getting enough reviews / pairing time? If not, where to reallocate?
- Career: interested in infra ownership vs IC depth — ask which they'd prefer and why.

Open items I want to surface:
- Load test schedule for perf/continuous-batching (need approval for 4h on dedicated infra)
- Pairing time: block 1h/week for codepairing with Dylan for next 3 sprints
- Mentorship: propose connecting report with Aisha for system-design sessions (30m x4)

Potential risks:
- If autoscale fix slips, rollback + mitigation plan required: fallback to single-model path and reduce traffic by 15%.
- Burnout: report logged longer hours — check capacity, consider shifting lower-priority work off their plate.

Action items (owner — due):
- Report: write 2-bullet RCA for throttling issue and post to #eng-growth (due 2026-08-10)
- Me (Ezra): request load-test quota and schedule 4h window with infra (due 2026-08-11)
- Report + Dylan: 60m pairing session to review KV cache refactor (schedule by 2026-08-12)
- Me: intro email to Aisha + candidate topics for mentorship (due 2026-08-13)

Notes to self (follow-ups):
- Bring metrics: CPU p95 during staging load tests, request rate distribution by model
- Check related ticket: JIRA-4289 (autoscale policy tuning) before next sync
- If PR still flaky, escalate to SRE for short-term circuit-breaker rule

Quick closing script:
"Thanks — that was helpful. I'll take the quota action and set up pairing. Can you post the 2-bullet RCA to #eng-growth by tomorrow? We'll re-evaluate sprint scope on Thursday."

Unresolved questions:
- Do they want more ownership of infra work (long-term)? or prefer product adjacent features?
- What signals would indicate readiness for an ownership rotation (metrics/PR count/depth)?

Back-of-envelope priorities for next 2 weeks:
- High: autoscale RCA + staging validation
- Medium: KV cache refactor pairing + code reviews
- Low: mentorship sessions scheduling

Timestamped log:
- 2026-08-03 09:12 — created draft
- 2026-08-06 14:30 — added load-test action
- 2026-08-09 08:45 — finalized action owners
